answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1454 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the reef. The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the onyx queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. A 207 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
